suggestions.title: Rebuild WT-like reference cohort from quiescent (non-pacemaker) Bed B cells for rd1 tests
suggestions.description: t0131 found all 8 WT-like reference cells fire ~73.5 Hz at rest with no input, so panels A and B have no valid WT baseline. Screen the 675-cell pool for cells with 0 Hz spontaneous rate and >=40 Hz evoked at +60 pA; require >=8 such cells. Falsifiable: if fewer than 8 exist, the pool cannot support rd1 comparisons. Recommended task types: experiment-run, data-analysis.

suggestions.title: Fit rd1 scaling to a firing-aware target on quiescent cells, not the sustained-current ratio alone
suggestions.description: t0131 fits hit the grid edge (s_Na 0.25, s_K up to 3.0) and left rd1-like cells silent at -10 mV. Using the quiescent cohort, extend the grid to s_Na 0.05-1.0 and s_K 1-6 and fit jointly sustained ratio 1.7, transient ratio 0.25, and evoked rate at +60 pA. Falsifiable: no scaling pair meets all three within 15% means Na/K scaling alone is insufficient. Recommended task types: experiment-run, comparative-analysis.

suggestions.title: Add persistent and resurgent Na scaling to explain the unreached Na transient ratio (0.455 vs 0.25)
suggestions.description: t0131 transient ratio only fell to 0.399-0.573 of WT-like even at the s_Na floor, suspected cause being unscaled persistent and resurgent Na channels. Add independent scale factors for these channels and rerun the 6x6 clamp grid on 8 cells. Falsifiable: the transient ratio reaches 0.25+-0.05 at a sustained ratio of 1.7+-0.15 or the hypothesis is rejected. Recommended task types: experiment-run.

suggestions.title: Test synaptic and dendritic conductance scaling as the driver of rd1 spontaneous hyperactivity
suggestions.description: Soma/AIS Na/K scaling gave rd1-like cells 0 Hz spontaneous activity; the dendritic arm gave only regular 5.4 Hz mean (ISI CV 0.005) versus the 4-10 Hz irregular target. Scale bipolar-input excitatory and inhibitory synaptic conductances and dendritic channels with noisy background drive, targeting 4-10 Hz and ISI CV above 0.5. Falsifiable: no setting meets both criteria on 5 of 8 cells. Recommended task types: experiment-run.

suggestions.title: Re-read panel A-D targets from raw researcher traces instead of by-eye PDF values
suggestions.description: All t0131 calibration targets (sustained ratio 1.7, assumed transient 0.25, 11 panel D anchors) were read by eye from SomeResults.pdf, and absolute panel C currents (~2 nA) differ from model values (~480 nA) by two orders of magnitude. Obtain raw traces and cell capacitance, extract targets with uncertainty, and refit. Falsifiable: the sustained ratio target stays within 1.7+-0.2 or is revised. Recommended task types: data-analysis.

suggestions.title: Measure signed DSI of rd1-like cells with a lower spike threshold and voltage-based selectivity
suggestions.description: rd1-like signed DSI was undefined on 8 of 8 cells because of the -10 mV spike threshold, while a post-hoc -30 mV threshold found attenuated spikes (peaks -21.8 and -29.5 mV) in 2 cells. Pre-declare a -30 mV threshold plus a PSP-amplitude DSI and recompute for all conditions. Falsifiable: DSI is defined on at least 6 of 8 rd1-like cells, else DSI is not measurable. Recommended task types: data-analysis.

suggestions.title: Validate panel D toy model against NEURON using quiescent cohort with leave-anchors-out fitting
suggestions.description: The panel D toy model matched 11 of 11 by-eye anchors by construction, while NEURON disproved 4 of 4 predictions, but the pacemaker baseline confounds that test. Refit the toy model on 6 anchors and predict the held-out 5, then rerun the NEURON u-sweep and three-pulse drive on quiescent cells. Falsifiable: held-out error above 20% or NEURON still disagrees on at least 3 of 4. Recommended task types: comparative-analysis, experiment-run.
